REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-25108  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Transactions and Use Tax
  Citizens' Advisory Committee meeting held Wednesday, August 23, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  23-25109  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Office of Ethics and
  Transparency regarding the Ethics Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  23-25110  Recommendation to confirm that the City Council’s adopted Measure A FY 24 plan,
  made as part of the Fiscal Year 24 Budget, conforms with the intent of Resolutions
  No. RES-16-0018 and RES-19-0127 prioritizing spending and with the language
  contained in the ballot measures as expressed in Resolution No. RES-16-0017 and
  RES-19-0173.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  23-25111  Recommendation to receive and file an update on the Long Beach Fire
  Department’s use of Measure A funding in Fiscal Year 23 to support Paramedic
  Rescue 12, and Engines 8 and 17, and uses of Measure A in FY 23.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
